text_block_list.text:
In the morning, I spotted Oguri Cap 
walking with a somewhat despondent look.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Kh... Why did I, back then...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...This morning, I had a dream where an 
endless full-course carrot meal kept 
coming out.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And just when I was savoring my bliss, 
buried in a mountain of carrots...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My eyes... opened. I didn't want to say 
'thanks for the meal' yet, I...

Even during the training that followed, 
Oguri Cap seemed lost in thought.
